title: Wire format specified in CDDL
description: Engineering consequence of Stakeholder directive: open standards for types and schemas; QR Code Generation, 5. Step 4 — Serialise as CBOR; HCERT Specification, 3.2.1 CWT Structure Overview; RFC 8610 Concise Data Definition Language (CDDL); RFC 9052 COSE: Structures and Process. QR Code Generation, 5. Step 4 — Serialise as CBOR: “The JSON shown throughout this page and in the logical models is schema notation only — the wire format is CBOR”.

statements.label: Wire format specified in CDDL
statements.requirement: The CBOR wire format (COSE_Sign1, protected header, CWT claim set, hcert map and payloads) SHALL be specified in CDDL (RFC 8610), and encoders SHALL produce data that validates against it. The envelope SHALL be hand-written from the HCERT Specification; payload rules SHALL be generated from the logical models (STT-PAY-010).

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-CBR-004 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: check_models.py).
